description: Room provider webhook handling, reconciliation and access enforcement.

preconditions: Meeting with an active session whose status left InProgress (the sitting ended).
LiveKit is configured and the provider room still exists.
cases.inputs: No caller arguments (cancellation token only); seeded: the active session and the provider room.
cases.return: The provider room is deleted and the session ended; open speaking requests are closed with it via SpeakingLeftAsync (a Left change is published when hands were up).

preconditions: Meeting InProgress with an active session; roster enforcement is on.
A person with no current access is still connected to the room.
cases.inputs: No caller arguments (cancellation token only); seeded: the session, the allowed-user list and the connected people.
cases.return: That person is taken out of the room; everyone still allowed keeps their recorded visits untouched.
cases.log: Removing {Identity} from {Room}: no longer allowed in.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; the provider room has allowed members connected but the database knows no session (every join notice was lost).
cases.inputs: No caller arguments (cancellation token only); seeded: the provider room with two allowed members, no session.
cases.return: One active session is created from the earliest join, and the present members get their visits recorded.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; roster enforcement is on.
A provider room exists for the meeting but nobody allowed is in it and no session is known.
cases.inputs: No caller arguments (cancellation token only); seeded: the orphan provider room.
